messages:
DeployBot: Automated notice: scheduled soft-unpin of runtime v2.14 -> v2.15 canary in eu-west at 2025-05-15T01:00:00Z. If any team wants a hold, reply with 'hold' within 45m. :rotating_light:
Maya: tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre. quick TL;DR: v2.15 has kernel perf for quantized llama3x but we saw a 0.6% change in top-p outputs during internal evals. not a blocker but worth guardrails.
Ryan: thanks. we should define microrollback criteria now so ops knows when to pin back automatically.
Tom: +1. propose microrollback if error-rate spike >2x baseline OR avg tail latency (p95) increases by >30ms sustained for >5min. also watch token dropouts.
Sara: add quality regression trigger: if regression on regression-set A (100 prompts) exceeds 1.5% exact-match delta OR hallucination increase by user-facing metric >1% -> rollback.
Carlos: can we make those signals available to deploybot? i.e. datapoints: p95_latency_ms, error_rate, quality_regression_pct.
Maya: yes. eng-sre will wire those. DeployBot: noted signals for alerting. would you like auto-pinback when thresholds hit? (yes/no)
Ryan: prefer auto-pinback for latency/error rules. quality regressions should be a manual review (ops + ml) before pinback.
Tom: agreed. auto-pinback = true for perf/safety failures, except quality regressions. also set cooldown: no more than 1 auto-pinback per region in 30m.
Sara: we should also add a soft-pin exception list: quant-v3b, llama3x-8k (these models previously flaked). keep them pinned until we verify kernel-matrix fixes.
Maya: noting exception list. sample pinlist snippet for deploybot:
```
pin_exceptions:
  - model: quant-v3b
  - model: llama3x-8k
auto_pinback: true
signals:
  - p95_latency_ms
  - error_rate
  - quality_regression_pct
```
Carlos: ops: do we have runbook steps for manual pinback? last time it was 6 steps but not codified.
Tom: i can draft. steps: 1) set pin in deploybot UI, 2) scale dedicated pool to drain canary, 3) create rollback tag & update pinlist metadata, 4) notify customers (if >SLA impact), 5) open incident if >10% traffic affected.
Maya: timeline: we will start canary at 01:00Z, ramp 10% then 30% after 20m, full after 2 hours if no flags.
Ryan: release notes blurb: "runtime v2.15: optimized quant kernels, improved batching for long-seq workloads. Known: small eval variance on top-p for some quant models. Exception list enforced."
Sara: I ran quick eval against regression set B — occasional token bias change on a few prompts. I'll post detailed diff in eng-ml channel.
Carlos: ops: please confirm alert thresholds and who gets paged.
Tom: pagerlist = eng-sre on-call, eng-runtime lead, on-call-ml. alert policy created and wired to deploybot.
Maya: decision: proceed with soft-unpin canary at 01:00Z. auto-pinback enabled for perf/errors, manual for quality regressions. exception pinlist applied for quant-v3b and llama3x-8k.
Ryan: +1
Sara: +1 (will follow up with diffs)
Carlos: +1
DeployBot: Acknowledged. Scheduling canary unpin event at 1750103600. Will post updates in thread and trigger pinback if configured thresholds are met. :gear:
Maya: thanks everyone — i'll update release notes and the release-ticket. if anyone sees anything odd after ramp, ping here and call the microrollback protocol. :eyes:
